verdict.rationale: Antigravity offers programmatic surfaces: a Python Agent SDK exposing the same tools, agent loop and context management that power the product, and a headless CLI mode for scripting agent tasks, CI integration and machine-readable output. There is no documented public network API for driving the product itself, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/HTTP API with a published spec, API reference docs for controlling sessions and projects programmatically, and independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK and headless automation.
